IS 8780 : 2004 Non-Destructive Testing of Steel Castings - Code of PracticeICS 77.040.20MTD 21Reaffirmed 20141 ScopeThis standard describes requirements and methods fornon-destructive testing of steel castings. These non-destructivetesting methods are intended to detect surface and internaldiscontinuities in castings.
